baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated فَمِنكُمْ/وَمِنكُم partitions one created addressee-set into كَافِر and مُؤْمِن, then places both before تَعْمَلُونَ and بَصِير.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation supplies the shared field; covering and heart-settled trust supply opposed orientations within it. Because the verse closes on intentional work and penetrating discernment, the nouns function as postures disclosed through conduct, not merely census labels.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the common created field from which the two postures emerge.
A covering action gives the first posture an obstructive relation to what could be disclosed.
Settled security and trust give the counter-posture a receptive, confiding relation.
Purposive action makes the opposed orientations operational rather than merely nominal.
Heart-level discernment makes the closing vision an appraisal beneath outward labels.

changed_reading.before: God created humanity; some are unbelievers, some believers; God sees their deeds.
changed_reading.after: Within one created human field, some enact a covering posture and some a settled trust; purposive conduct discloses the difference to a discernment that reaches the heart.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَكُمْ precedes the bifurcation, while تَعْمَلُونَ follows it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The creation inventory opens not only origination but measure, inward disposition, and readiness. Read with intentional work, this permits a capacity model: humans are formed with measured dispositions and preparedness, while the named orientations become legible in what those capacities are used to do.

activation_trace.role: Measuring before action supplies a calibrated rather than undifferentiated account of creation.
An inward disposition supplies the latent layer from which conduct can arise.
Readiness for an outcome supplies capacity without by itself fixing which outcome occurs.
Intended doing is the conversion point from latent readiness to observable orientation.

changed_reading.before: The two religious classes appear as finished products immediately after creation.
changed_reading.after: Creation can be heard as measured endowment and readiness, with covering or trusting orientation becoming actual in purposive work; the verse leaves the exact relation between endowment and choice open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding cosmic field is wholly encompassed by praise, sovereignty, and measured governance. The human split therefore becomes bounded divergence inside one dominion, not two rival ontological domains.

activation_trace.role: Measured creation anchors the local human partition in a calibrated field.
Freedom from defect supplies a cosmic frame larger than the subsequent human refusal.
Sovereignty supplies the single governing domain that contains both human postures.
Encompassing totality prevents the مِنْكُمْ split from exhausting the created whole.
Deliberate apportionment links cosmic capability to the measured creation named next.

structural_cues: 64:1 moves from cosmic totality to 64:2's twice-repeated مِنْكُمْ without changing the sovereign subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totality, sovereignty, measure, and immediate sequence; I infer that the human divergence is contained rather than co-sovereign. A live alternative is that 64:1 is only a doxological preface and does not constrain the partition this tightly.

changed_reading.before: Believer and disbeliever divide the human scene into two self-standing camps.
changed_reading.after: Their divergence is real but local: both postures arise within one measured creation and remain enclosed by a sovereignty the split cannot divide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats creation, specifies truth-grounded forming and good forms, then names return. This resists treating the كافر/مؤمن contrast as a visible fabrication defect: the same well-formed creatures take morally divergent trajectories toward an endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Renewed origination continues the focus creation statement into a larger formed order.
Reality-matching firmness makes the created order sound non-arbitrary.
Embodied configuration locates visible form on a different axis from the moral partition.
Goodness against ugliness blocks a simple reading of disbelief as malformed appearance.
Movement toward an outcome gives the two postures trajectory and consequence.

structural_cues: 64:3 repeats خَلَقَ and the plural object كُمْ, then adds formed appearance and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truthful creation, good form, and return; I infer that the 64:2 difference is not a defect in bodily manufacture. The live alternative is that حسن qualifies appearance only and says nothing about moral capacity.

changed_reading.before: The juxtaposition with creation can sound as though unbelief and belief are manufactured traits of two human kinds.
changed_reading.after: The contrast cuts across a truthfully made and well-formed humanity; it names divergent moral trajectories within good created form, oriented toward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secret and public action are traced back to the chest as their source, while the surah closes by pairing the hidden with the witnessed and accurate judgment. بَصِير therefore spans outward deed, inward motive, and the transition between them.

activation_trace.role: Direct sight supplies the manifest side of divine appraisal.
Inward discernment supplies access to motive and self-knowledge beneath the deed.
Disclosure to a knower joins the repeated knowing clauses into one comprehensive field.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden phase of action.
Public manifestation supplies the outward phase paired with concealment.
The source from which acts issue locates moral work upstream in the chest.
What is screened from eyes extends the closing scope beyond ordinary observation.
Presence with witnessing supplies the fully manifest counterpart to the hidden.
Accurate wisdom turns comprehensive seeing into discerning appraisal rather than bare surveillance.

structural_cues: 64:4 pairs what is concealed and declared before naming what breasts contain; 64:18 closes the surah with hidden/witnessed symmetry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired visibility states, an interior source, and wise knowledge; I infer a path from motive through deed to appraisal. A live alternative is to keep each divine attribute as parallel assurance without a causal path.

changed_reading.before: God visually monitors what people do.
changed_reading.after: Divine seeing follows work from its concealed source through public manifestation and judges both layers with informed discernment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The historical sequence supplies incoming report, clarifying signs, a spoken objection, covering, and turning away; the resurrection sequence then stirs the still and reports work back. كافر becomes a repeated response enacted after disclosure, not an unexplained substance installed at creation.

activation_trace.role: Blocking acknowledged truth supplies the focus label's specifically epistemic force.
A delivered report supplies prior disclosure rather than informational absence.
Meaning made plain by speech or sign supplies the clarity met by refusal.
Overt utterance makes the refusal an articulated act.
Truth-blocking follows the clarified message in the packet's own sequence.
Turning the back converts verbal resistance into directional withdrawal.
Assertion without certainty exposes the denial as a maintained claim rather than knowledge.
Rousing what was still reverses attempted closure and reopens the human record.
The returning report makes completed work answer the earlier rejected report.
Purposive deeds become the content eventually disclosed back to their actors.

structural_cues: 64:5-7 runs disclosure -> objection -> covering/turning -> reanimation -> report of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered response chain; I infer that this sequence explains how the focus noun becomes actual. A live alternative is that the later history illustrates only some disbelievers and should not define every occurrence in 64:2.

changed_reading.before: A disbeliever is simply one member of a class present after creation.
changed_reading.after: The class-name condenses a process: disclosure arrives, a claim resists it, truth is covered, the person turns away, and suppressed work is finally raised and reported.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to believe addresses hearers as capable of response, while delivered light provides an enabling disclosure and work remains the test. This makes the focus partition mobile and invitational rather than a closed inventory of immutable kinds.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent appears as an imperative response, making the posture actionable.
Illumination supplies what can replace the focus posture of covering.
Delivery into reach makes the illuminating disclosure available rather than self-generated.
Intentional conduct remains the operational test after the command to believe.
Knowledge of an affair's interior parallels the focus seeing and reaches response quality.

structural_cues: 64:8 directly commands ءَامِنُوا after 64:5-7 narrates repeated كَفَرُوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed repeated verbs and an imperative; I infer real posture-mobility within the addressed field. A live alternative is that the command targets a mixed audience without implying that every named individual can cross categories.

changed_reading.after: 64:2 names live response positions: covering can be answered by an imperative toward trusting assent under delivered light, with subsequent work exposing the response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same covering root that names the resistant person in 64:2 later names removal-by-covering of that person's bad acts when trust and fitting work occur; forgiveness adds protective covering. Moral force therefore lies not in covering as a bare operation but in what is covered, by whom, and toward what repair.

activation_trace.role: Bare covering supplies the shared operation whose object will be reversed.
Trusting assent supplies the condition for the later reparative covering.
Purposive work makes the condition practical rather than merely confessional.
Fitness against corruption specifies the kind of work joined to trust.
Effacing wrong by covering it reverses the focus root's agent, object, and moral direction.
Badness supplies the object whose covering repairs rather than obstructs disclosure.
Protective concealment of fault extends covering into preservation of the wrongdoer from its effect.

structural_cues: 64:2 uses the ك ف ر root as a human noun; 64:9 returns it as an act God performs upon bad deeds, and 64:14 repeats human and divine forgiving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a root recurrence with changed agents and objects; I infer that object-direction, not the physical image alone, carries the ethical polarity. A live alternative keeps the conventional derivations semantically separate and hears only wordplay, not a governing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Covering is simply the negative essence of the kāfir, opposed to belief.
changed_reading.after: Covering is ethically reversible: humans culpably cover disclosed truth, while God reparatively covers bad acts and believers may protectively cover faults; relation and object determine the reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adverse event still strikes, but permission bounds it and belief is followed by guidance of the heart. Belief in the focus ayah is therefore not immunity from impact; it is a mode by which impact is received and the inner center is redirected.

activation_trace.role: A calamity that lands on a person supplies the unavoidable external impact.
Authorization bounds the event without redescribing it as harmless.
Settled trust supplies stability within, rather than escape from, the impact.
Gentle direction supplies the path by which trust changes the aftermath.
The heart names the interior site where the event is processed.
Turning something from its prior face supplies the reorientation enacted in that interior site.
Knowledge disclosed to the knower closes the process under comprehensive awareness.

structural_cues: 64:11 keeps calamity, belief, and heart-guidance in one conditional sequence rather than promising prevention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impact, authorization, trust, direction, and heart in order; I infer a reception-and-reorientation mechanism. A live alternative reads heart-guidance as general doctrinal guidance unrelated to processing calamity.

changed_reading.before: A believer is a person who holds the correct proposition.
changed_reading.after: A believer is also one whose settled trust lets a real blow become an occasion for guided reorientation of the heart rather than renewed covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Obedience receives the message, turning away rejects it, the messenger's burden stops at delivery, and believers entrust the outcome to God. مؤمن thus acquires a relational practice: responsive compliance plus delegated reliance, not cognitive assent alone.

activation_trace.role: Willing compliance converts inward assent into responsive conduct.
Message-bearing supplies the relation to which obedience or refusal responds.
Turning away supplies the directional counter-action to willing compliance.
Carrying the message to its recipient limits the messenger's responsibility at delivery.
Handing an affair over supplies the believer's enacted reliance beyond receipt of the message.
Trust and security bind the focus label to this practice of entrustment.

structural_cues: 64:12 contrasts obedience and turning away; 64:13 immediately restricts deity and commands believers to entrust themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, response, and entrustment; I infer a single relational profile for مؤمن. A live alternative treats obedience and reliance as consequences of an already complete category rather than constituents that clarify it.

changed_reading.before: Believer names inward assent, with works appended afterward.
changed_reading.after: Believer names a trust relation enacted by receiving, obeying, and entrusting, while refusal takes the opposite bodily direction of turning away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those explicitly addressed as believers still meet adversarial pressure in spouses and children, undergo assay through possessions, and confront withholding inside the self. The 64:2 partition remains socially real but recurs inside intimate relations and self-governance; faith is a maintained response under internal pressure, not a clean external border.

activation_trace.role: Directly addressed assent establishes that the following hazards occur within a believing audience.
A paired intimate relation moves opposition inside the nearest social bond.
What proceeds from oneself makes the pressure internally generated as well as external.
Enmity supplies active opposition within those intimate relations.
Alert self-protection shows that the believer's posture requires maintenance.
Assaying a person as metal makes possessions and offspring reveal rather than merely accompany orientation.
Placing the self under protection supplies active regulation against the inner hazard.
The mind and inward alarm locate the decisive conflict inside the acting self.
Grasping refusal to release supplies an internal covering-like counterforce to faithful action.

structural_cues: 64:14 addresses believers before naming intimate enemies; 64:15 calls intimate goods a test; 64:16 locates the hazard in one's own نفس.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective partition and later internalized pressures; I infer a recursive application of the opposition within households and selves. The live alternative, and primary grammatical reading, keeps مِنْكُمْ in 64:2 strictly as a partition among persons.

changed_reading.before: Believers and disbelievers occupy a clean boundary between separate people.
changed_reading.after: The between-person distinction remains, but its mechanism recurs within believers' households and selves, where trust must repeatedly answer enmity, assay, fear, and withholding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Loss in exchange, possessions under assay, wages, a cut portion advanced for return, multiplication, and gratitude form an economy of action. تَعْمَلُونَ becomes invested labor whose true yield is disclosed later, while belief and covering encode rival valuations of what is worth advancing or withholding.

activation_trace.role: The wage attached to labor opens an economic valuation of the focus deeds.
Shortchanging in an exchange supplies the eventual exposure of false valuation.
Accumulated property supplies the asset that can conceal or reveal allegiance under test.
Compensation for work links action to a yield held beyond immediate possession.
Cutting off an advance so its recompense returns models faithful expenditure as deliberate investment.
Increase by an equal amount supplies multiplication of the advanced act.
A small input whose effect becomes visible supplies the economy's disproportionate yield.

structural_cues: 64:9 names the day of loss-exchange; 64:15-17 move through wealth, wage, advance, multiplication, and appreciative return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained transaction lexicon; I infer that it retrospectively models focus عمل as invested value. A live alternative treats these as separate eschatological and charitable metaphors without one economic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God sees generic good or bad behavior.
changed_reading.after: God appraises purposive labor whose apparent present cost and eventual yield differ; covering withholds value, while trust advances it toward a return that exposes mistaken accounting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates non-dominant و س م and س م م mappings under the contextual root س م و rather than the ordinary heaven sense. It remains packet-authorized and anchored in بَصِير plus the secret/public pairing, but downstream prose should call it a split-map echo about legibility, never a lexical gloss of سَمَاوَات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَصِير can hold together visible and inward discernment at the close of the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Eye-sight supplies reading of an outwardly visible mark.
Heart-insight supplies reading of an inward quality unavailable to ordinary sight.
A visible identifying trace activates the outward legibility pole through the split mapping.
An interiorly lodged property activates the inward legibility pole through another split mapping.
Interior concealment keeps the inward pole from collapsing into visible labeling.
Public manifestation keeps the outward pole distinct while placing both under one knower.

changed_reading.before: The closing attribute sees deeds after the two labels are assigned.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory split-map echo, the closing attribute reads both the marks by which a posture becomes publicly known and the inward property those marks may conceal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it uses agricultural, hydraulic, and sprouting branches rather than the focus noun's ordinary doctrinal sense. It remains anchored in كَافِر and تَعْمَلُونَ and forms a visible material mechanism across later commands, but it should be rendered only as an exploratory analogy, not as the etymological meaning of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus كَافِر has a seed-covering branch, and the verse makes purposive work the field in which orientation is seen.

activation_trace.role: Burying seed makes covering potentially productive and opens the model's central ambiguity.
Purposive labor anchors the material cycle in human action rather than free-floating nature imagery.
Soft growing ground supplies the medium in which hidden input can become visible yield.
A passage with an outlet makes expenditure a release into circulation.
Ground that holds back runoff gives stinginess a sealed, non-circulating material behavior.
The cultivator who opens soil supplies labor that turns burial into growth rather than closure.
Fresh shoots make hidden investment visibly return above the surface.

changed_reading.before: The covering image is uniformly sterile and opposed to all faithful action.
changed_reading.after: The material echo distinguishes concealment that seals truth and hoards flow from temporary burial that, through released labor, opens into growth; deeds reveal which kind of covering occurred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because a secondary ك ف ر branch depicts a bowed submissive gesture, apparently reversing the expected surface of disbelief. It remains anchored by the focus contrast among كافر, مؤمن, and بصير and is sharpened by secret/public context; downstream prose should present it as a warning generated by a remote branch image, not claim that كَافِر literally means an outward worshipper.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah contrasts the two labels but closes with a discernment of work that can penetrate outward presentation.

activation_trace.role: A lowered gesture of submission supplies the paradoxical possibility that a compliant surface can itself cover.
Assent that settles in the heart supplies the interior criterion not guaranteed by posture.
Heart-penetrating insight prevents visible submission from deciding the classification.
What is hidden inwardly supplies the possible contradiction beneath the gesture.
Public display supplies the readable but potentially misleading surface.
The source from which acts issue relocates decisive orientation behind the displayed posture.

changed_reading.before: Kāfir and believer can be identified from opposed visible religious postures.
changed_reading.after: An outwardly submissive posture may still function as a cover; the distinction finally depends on heart-settled assent and the source of action visible to deeper discernment.

strongest_changes: The focus partition shifted from fixed created essences to enacted and potentially mobile response postures after disclosure.
The ك ف ر recurrence reversed covering's moral direction: covering truth obstructs, while covering bad acts or faults repairs and protects.
بَصِير expanded from observation of outward deeds to discernment of hidden source, public manifestation, and heart-reorientation under impact.
The later household, self, and transaction sequences made the binary recur in intimate pressure, self-regulation, and the valuation of work.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several readings without forcing a verdict: a strong response-chain reading, a covering-object reversal, an impact-processing model of faith, and contained split-root and material analogies that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: 64:3's good forming may distinguish bodily form from moral posture, but it may refer only to appearance.
The imperative in 64:8 supports posture-mobility but does not by itself prove that every individual can cross the named categories.
The recursive within-household and within-self reading supplements rather than replaces the primary collective grammar of مِنْكُمْ.
Non-dominant split mappings and cultivation imagery are activation mechanisms, not lexical claims about the contextual surface forms.
